sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 7, National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) (Amendment) Order 1984
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 7 OF 1984
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
7 OF 1984
NATIONAL AND
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (BASIS OF ELECTIONS) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th October, 1984]
No. F. 17 (2)/84-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information :-
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order:--
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order may be -called the National and Provincial
Assemblies (Basis of Elections) (Amendment) Order, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 1, P.
O. No. 14 of 1979.-In the National and Provincial Assemblies (Basis of
Elections) Order, 1979 (P. O. No. 14 of 1979), in Article 1, clause (2) shall
be omitted.
